readerSummary.zh-CN: 以 productId、locale 取得注册文案和标语。完整、紧凑和首行共用产品图形，TCRN 产品字标的后缀使用各自的深色。
readerSummary.en: Pass productId and locale for registered wording and taglines. Full, rail and first-line lockups share the mark. TCRN wordmark suffixes use their product’s deep color.
readerSummary.ja: productId と locale で登録文言を選びます。フル版・レール版・先頭行は同じマークを使います。TCRN のワードマークの接尾部には各製品の濃色を使います。
readerSummary.ko: productId와 locale로 등록 문구와 태그라인을 선택합니다. 전체·레일·첫 줄은 같은 마크를 사용합니다. TCRN 워드마크의 접미부에는 해당 제품의 짙은 색을 사용합니다.
readerSummary.fr: Fournir productId et locale pour les textes et slogans enregistrés. Les blocs complet, rail et première ligne partagent le symbole. Les suffixes TCRN utilisent la couleur foncée de leur produit.

typeDefinitions.name: TcrnProductLogoId
typeDefinitions.declaration: export type TcrnProductLogoId = keyof typeof tcrnProductLogoRegistry;

layout.constraint: Registered mark and scale fix the graphic; copy uses remaining parent space and truncates where specified. Keep the complete lockup geometry.

example.snippet:
case "ProductLockup": return state === "products" ? tcrnProductMarkIds.map(productId => <ProductLockup key={productId} productId={productId} locale={locale} />)
        : <ProductLockup productId="tms" locale={locale} scale={state === "rail" ? "rail" : "lockup"} firstLine={state === "first-line" ? "rail" : undefined} />;
